findings.observed: The exact-current main labeler validates branches using branch_id, validity, evidence_for and evidence_against. It does not require the current integrated Hyperposition tuple v/K/E+/E-/F/T/A/sigma or projection_visibility.
findings.contract_conflict: The current cross-cutting contract requires branch-local v_semantic_value, K_context_predicate, E_plus, E_minus, F_falsifier, T_validity_scope, A_origin_provenance, sigma_epistemic_status and projection visibility where context filtering exists.
findings.reuse: Retain current code as a narrow deterministic donor; do not treat its passing tests as sufficient D/E training admission.

findings.observed: The current test suite intentionally marks b0 PROVEN_WITHIN_SYNTHETIC_WORLD and then expects D_resolve(state) to resolve b0 while b1 and b2 remain LIVE and no discriminator object is supplied.
findings.risk: A proved branch does not by itself establish that other live branches are mutually exclusive or falsified. Without an explicit exclusivity/coverage certificate, this can train premature unique collapse in multi-cause or compatible-alternative episodes.
findings.required_repair: Either encode PROVE as an explicit decisive discriminator/exclusivity certificate covering every competing live alternative, or keep resolution UNRESOLVED until an adequate discriminator/falsifier closes the alternatives.

findings.observed: Current U_d_test_order uses admissibility, number of separated live pairs, one cost_rank and stable ID.
findings.counterdesign: The parallel #2009 contract additionally minimizes worst-case remaining indistinguishable partition and separates safety/risk, execution cost and coordination cost as ordinal classes.
findings.hard_boundary: Do not fabricate calibrated expected-information-gain probabilities when no probability model is admitted.

findings.observed: Current f_salience_rank correctly emits no truth, probability or evidence-strength output, but its ordering uses only actionability/scope/freshness ranks.
findings.counterdesign: The parallel #2009 contract factorizes authority-boundary risk, urgency, live-discriminator relevance, current-goal relevance and novel independent evidence.

findings.observed: The current main labeler fails closed on canonical-truth/effect-authority leakage, preserves branches instead of deleting them, marks same-provenance ancestry nonindependent, keeps ordinary support/weaken updates nonresolving, and keeps discriminator/salience outputs nonprobabilistic.

The current version ledger was committed immediately before the labeler implementation and invariant-test commits, so the new labeler itself is not yet fully dispositioned as a first-class artifact record at the exact current head.

Supervisor 8.78 and the current conditional nuisance audit reject direct training on binding-router factorial v3 because higher-order visible nuisance signatures remain target-informative despite marginal balance.

external_method_research.source: Wu, Geiger & Milliere, How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?, ICML 2025, PMLR 267:67284-67299
external_method_research.method_input: Transformers trained on symbolic variable dereferencing show a developmental trajectory from chance to shallow heuristic to systematic dereferencing; causal interventions identify residual-stream addressable-memory behavior and specialized attention routing in the studied model.
external_method_research.trigger2_delta: Keep direct/one-hop/two-hop proof topology, distractor chains, developmental checkpoint curves and causal mechanism tests as explicit binder acceptance dimensions rather than using final symbol accuracy alone.
external_method_research.nonclaim: This paper does not prove that Xeno/Qwen3.5-0.8B will learn the same circuit.

external_method_research.source: Farquhar et al., Detecting hallucinations in large language models using semantic entropy, Nature 630, 625-630 (2024)
external_method_research.method_input: Meaning-level uncertainty can differ from token/surface variability.
external_method_research.trigger2_delta: Use only as later evaluation/calibration inspiration for semantic alternative sets; do not convert semantic entropy, branch count, recurrence or salience into branch truth.

external_method_research.source: Tayebati et al., CAP: Conformalized Abstention Policies for Context-Adaptive Risk Management for LLMs and VLMs, PMLR 304:926-941 (2025)
external_method_research.method_input: Set prediction and abstention can be evaluated under explicit calibration/coverage frameworks.
external_method_research.trigger2_delta: Potential future evaluation layer for UNRESOLVED/ABSTAIN behavior after deterministic semantic label semantics are fixed; not a replacement for U/D labelers and not truth authority.

Fuse its fail-closed authority fences, ancestry idempotence and branch-preservation behavior with the stricter full-tuple Hyperposition contract and one explicit unique-resolution criterion.
Choose and version one probability-free discriminator-order semantics and one salience-order semantics; preserve alternatives as explicit research candidates until chosen.

Add full-schema property tests: branch permutation, context UNKNOWN, projection-not-deletion, falsifier-context interaction, compatible-vs-mutually-exclusive proof, evidence ancestry idempotence, counterfactual branch-local update, and no-resolution without decisive coverage.
Run the upgraded candidate gate on the exact model-visible serialization so evaluator metadata and relation labels cannot leak.
Only then generate a counterbalanced Hyperposition-native successor corpus and retrofit the highest-value existing process/binding/evidence families.
